title: Private DR: alert on missed backup windows + repeated failures (with runbook links + noise reduction)
author: Sergio Costa
release_notes:
- Adds alerting for missed Private backup windows and repeated failures.
- Adds noise-reduction/inhibition for paused clusters and maintenance/restore mode.
- Standardizes runbook links/annotations for Private backup/restore alerts.
commits: alerts(private-backup): add recording rules for last success + consecutive failures
alerts(private-backup): inhibit during maintenance/restore + ignore paused clusters
docs: add runbook link conventions + examples for Private alerts
ci: update alert rule tests + golden files
body:
Summary: This PR adds two customer-operator facing alerts to the observability-pack for Redwood Private Day-2 ops: (1) missed scheduled backup windows and (2) repeated backup failures. It also standardizes alert annotations so every page links directly to the relevant Confluence runbook, and includes noise-reduction logic to avoid paging for intentionally paused clusters or clusters in maintenance/restore mode.

Context / Motivation: During DR drill prep and recent Support escalations, we saw two recurring problems: operators didn’t notice that backups had silently stopped (missed window), and we had noisy alerting that fired repeatedly on clusters that were paused or mid-restore. This implements the SRE requirements captured in ENG-4869 and aligns alert metadata conventions with the dashboard work from pr_229.

What’s included: Adds recording rules: rw_private_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster_id,namespace,backup_target} and rw_private_backup_consecutive_failures{cluster_id,namespace,backup_target}. Adds alert BackupWindowMissed that fires when time() - last_success > expected_window + grace (defaults: window=24h, grace=2h) and the cluster has backups enabled. Adds alert BackupRepeatedFailures that fires on consecutive_failures >= 3 within the configured window. Adds inhibition / noise reduction: (a) do not alert when rw_private_cluster_state{state="paused"}=1, (b) do not alert when rw_private_maintenance_mode_enabled=1 or rw_private_restore_in_progress=1, (c) add a short hold-off to prevent flapping immediately after a restore drill completes. Adds runbook links in alert annotations using the convention runbook_url + a short title; links point to Eng SRE + Eng Private Confluence pages. Updates docs with the exact annotation keys and examples. Updates rule tests and fixtures.

Alert details: BackupWindowMissed: severity=page for strict tier (label strict_rpo="true"), severity=ticket otherwise; default for=30m; annotations include runbook_url and dashboard_url. BackupRepeatedFailures: severity=page when failures >= 5 and last_success_age > 12h, severity=warning when failures >= 3; default for=15m; includes top failure reason label when present (e.g., AccessDenied) to reduce time-to-triage.

Runbook links: BackupWindowMissed and BackupRepeatedFailures both link to the SRE troubleshooting page and the operator ‘create + verify backup’ runbook (operators start there, SRE uses the troubleshooting page). The docs specify that downstream Alertmanager routes can choose which link to display, but we ship both annotations.

Notes on noise reduction: This PR intentionally uses explicit state signals (paused/maintenance/restore) rather than time-based muting alone. That keeps alerts useful for real failures while avoiding false positives during planned work. We also include a guard so ‘missed window’ doesn’t fire on newly installed clusters until at least one successful backup has occurred (preventing noisy onboarding).

Testing: Updated promtool rule tests with synthetic metrics for: (1) normal daily backups, (2) missed window, (3) repeated failures, (4) paused cluster, (5) restore in progress. Validated locally against a snapshot from a recent Private staging environment.

Follow-ups: After this merges, we should update incident-bot’s /backup-status shortcut to include the ‘last successful backup age’ panel (tracked in ENG-4920), and we should revisit default windows for customers with strict RPO tiers (Miles/Rafael tracking in DR game day notes).
review_conversation: Allison Grant (review): Can we align alert names and label keys with the metrics naming thread (rw_private_*)? Also please ensure annotations include both dashboard_url and runbook_url so incident-bot can unfurl consistently.

Sergio Costa (author): Updated all recording rules and alerts to rw_private_* prefix and added dashboard_url + runbook_url annotations in both alerts. Also added docs/alerting/runbook-linking.md with the convention.
Rafael Mendes (review): The missed-window alert will be noisy for new installs that haven’t had their first backup yet. Can we gate on ‘has_ever_succeeded’ or similar?

Sergio Costa (author): Added rw_private_backup_has_ever_succeeded recording rule and a condition in BackupWindowMissed so we only evaluate missed-window after the first successful backup has been observed.
Sean Gallagher (review): Please add inhibition for maintenance/restore mode. We saw this during the last staged drill—pages kept firing while restore was running.
Sergio Costa (author): Added inhibition based on rw_private_maintenance_mode_enabled=1 and rw_private_restore_in_progress=1. Included a hold-off period post-restore to avoid immediate flapping.
Miles Thornton (review): Severity split looks good, but can we document the strict tier behavior (page vs ticket) so Solutions knows what to expect?

Sergio Costa (author): Added a short section in docs/alerting/private-backup-restore-alerts.md describing severity mapping and the strict_rpo label convention. Also referenced the DR planning guidance so it’s consistent.
Allison Grant (final): Approved. CI green and the rule tests cover the key cases.
